text:
zoe: heads up — found a reproducible flaky where Retrofit.enqueue callbacks arrive after call.cancel() on Android 14 emulator.
rahul: are you on okhttp 4.11? any custom dispatcher or callbackExecutor?
zoe: okhttp 4.11.0, default dispatcher, retryOnConnectionFailure=true. minimal repro: press cancel immediately after enqueue button. sometimes onResponse still fires. logs: 
``nI/APP: enqueue
I/APP: cancel pressed
I/APP: onResponse - 204
```
mike: quick workaround: in onResponse check call.isCanceled() and ignore if true. also recommend setting retryOnConnectionFailure(false) in repro to see if retries cause the duplicate deliveries.
rahul: we should add guidance to SDK docs: wrap Call in suspendCancellableCoroutine and invokeOnCancellation -> call.cancel(), and always verify coroutine isActive before resume.
ci-bot: CI job queued: repro-matrix (api 30,33,34)
zoe: thanks — i'll try the guard and flip retryOnConnectionFailure off, will paste CI link.
